entries.title: Mount & Blade

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The original Mount & Blade is a Windows-only release, so the PC version is both the only sourced release route and the highest-fidelity route for the 2008 game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam, GOG, or TaleWorlds' own download route. Consider Warband separately if you want the expanded multiplayer-era standalone game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Warband is a standalone expansion/follow-up and is listed separately; it should not be collapsed into the original 2008 game.

entries.title: Mount & Blade: Warband
entries.definitive_edition: Mount & Blade: Warband on Windows PC with Viking Conquest and Napoleonic Wars

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with Viking Conquest and Napoleonic Wars available
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and most complete Warband route, with mod support, DLC access, and the best capture/settings flexibility. PS4 and Xbox One are valid console ports but lack the PC mod/DLC ecosystem and add no sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version on Steam or GOG. Add Viking Conquest and Napoleonic Wars if you want the official expansion/DLC content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Warband is a standalone expansion/follow-up to Mount & Blade. Viking Conquest and Napoleonic Wars are official expansion/DLC content, not separate mainline entries.

entries.title: Mount & Blade: With Fire & Sword
entries.definitive_edition: Mount & Blade: With Fire & Sword on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: With Fire & Sword is a Windows PC standalone expansion/spin-off, so PC is both the only sourced release route and the highest-fidelity way to play it.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, GOG, or TaleWorlds' download route.

entries.remaster_caveats: With Fire & Sword is a standalone spin-off/expansion, not DLC inside Warband and not the same entry as the original Mount & Blade.

entries.title: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
entries.definitive_edition: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord on Windows PC with War Sails

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native high-end PC presentation with mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with War Sails available
primary.why: The Windows PC version has the highest settings/capture ceiling, mod support, and the complete current content path including War Sails. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are strong current-gen routes for the base game and War Sails, while PS4 and Xbox One are last-gen base-game routes without the same current-gen expansion fit.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG, or Microsoft Store, and add War Sails for the naval expansion content.

entries.remaster_caveats: War Sails is DLC/expansion content, not a separate game entry. PS4 and Xbox One are last-generation base-game routes and should not be treated as the definitive expansion route.
